title: A 13-Foot Python Tried to Eat an Alligator and Burst

scenes.text: A python swallowed an alligator. Then it burst.
In 2005, researchers in the Florida Everglades found a thirteen-foot Burmese python, dead.
Sticking out of a hole in its middle was a six-foot alligator.
Alligator skin was found inside the snake, so it had really tried to swallow the whole thing.
Park researchers think the meal was simply too big for its body to handle.

description:
A thirteen-foot Burmese python was found dead in the Everglades with a six-foot alligator sticking out of it.
In 2005 researchers believed the snake tried to swallow the gator whole and its stomach ruptured.
Would you ever go into the Everglades?
first_comment: Burmese pythons are not native to Florida. Should wild ones be removed? Tell us below.
